title: Custom Lock-Free Stack/Queue instead of Standard Channels
pattern: Writing custom concurrent lock-free queue channels with atomic spin checks instead of using standard proven channel libraries.
why_bad: Custom concurrent containers are highly prone to data races, compiler optimization hazards, and memory leaks. Standard channels (`std::sync::mpsc` or `crossbeam-channel`) are heavily optimized, battle-tested, and perform much better under high thread contention [29, 217].
detection: A custom atomic pointer swap loop (`compare_exchange`) for thread communication instead of safe standard library channels.
counterexample: Writing a highly specific, single-purpose low-level lock-free library for academic research or benchmark verification. `Contextual`.
fix: Use standard library or crossbeam channels.
